prompt:
The same photograph as the reference picture, retouched in one place only: the lower middle of the picture, where the young man in the dark-blue jacket stands, now shows the room behind him.

There, the pale wooden floorboards run on down to the bottom edge of the picture, in the same light and with the same grain as the rest of the floor. The whole low wooden coffee table is visible, with its white coffee cup and the open pizza box on it, and the brown dog lies asleep under the table, its whole body now in view, its head on its paws. His small grey travel suitcase stands upright on its own on the floorboards near the bottom edge, its handle pulled up, as if it had just been put down there.

Everything else in the picture stays exactly as it is in the reference picture, in the same place, the same size and the same light: the wardrobe with the football on top, the grey sofa and the open book, the guitar between the wardrobe and the sofa, the sneakers under the sofa, the crooked painting, the window and the radiator, the plant with its fairy lights, the floor lamp with the red sock, the paper lampshade with the black umbrella hanging from it, the bicycle in front of the bookshelf, the goldfish bowl, the television and the slice of pizza on its plate, the bucket of green bottles, the cardboard box with the cat in it, the balloons and the open door on the right.
